cancellationReason.title: Cancellation Reason
cancellationReason.description: Picklist/API reason for CANCEL when your org captures it.

clinicalEncounterStatus.title: CE Status API
clinicalEncounterStatus.description: Override ClinicalEncounter Status for BOOK; default Scheduled.

correlationId.title: Correlation Id
correlationId.description: Session or conversation id for Agent_Action_Log / tracing; optional but recommended.

healthcareFacilityId.title: Healthcare Facility Id
healthcareFacilityId.description: HealthcareFacility Id for BOOK. MODIFY/CANCEL infer facility from existing SA.

healthcareProviderId.title: Healthcare Provider Id
healthcareProviderId.description: Optional HealthcareProvider Id when patient names a doctor for BOOK.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: BOOK = create ServiceAppointment + ClinicalEncounter (+ provider when set). MODIFY = reschedule existing SA (needs serviceAppointmentId). CANCEL = cancel SA/encounter (needs serviceAppointmentId). Uppercase.

parentRecordId.title: Parent Record Id
parentRecordId.description: Often required on ServiceAppointment for BOOK (org-specific parent work object).

patientAccountId.title: Patient Account Id
patientAccountId.description: Person Account Id after verification. Required for BOOK, MODIFY, and CANCEL.

schedEndOrNewEnd.title: Sched End / New End
schedEndOrNewEnd.description: Appointment end (BOOK) or new end time (MODIFY).

schedStartOrNewStart.title: Sched Start / New Start
schedStartOrNewStart.description: Appointment start (BOOK) or new start time (MODIFY). Use patient-local intent; stored as Datetime.

serviceAppointmentId.title: Service Appointment Id
serviceAppointmentId.description: Existing ServiceAppointment Id for MODIFY or CANCEL.

serviceAppointmentStatus.title: SA Status API
serviceAppointmentStatus.description: Override ServiceAppointment Status API value for BOOK; default Scheduled.

serviceAppointmentStatusCategory.title: SA StatusCategory API
serviceAppointmentStatusCategory.description: Optional StatusCategory when your org requires it.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Optional short subject on the ServiceAppointment for BOOK.

workTypeId.title: Work Type Id
workTypeId.description: Optional WorkType Id for BOOK when the org ties visit length to work type.
